title: 第578章 十恶不赦的天意宗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那里，一位单手持剑的白衫老人脚踏巨石，屹立在废墟之中，手中，是那柄完好无损的玄屠古剑。

“陛下，这也不能全怪张太尉。”见刘邦有点不悦，萧何忙提张良说好话道。

随后，白杨先是记录了一下刚刚测试的数据，随后来到威震天旁边，准备为其修复声音讯息系统。

齐宣只觉眼前金光大作，刺眼无比，待他忍不住闭上眼睛之后，却又感觉金光瞬间消失。

就连上次的第二名，还是因为华夏凭一己之力，制约我们三个国家联手，才落了下分。

怎么就有人直接化身遮天蔽日，不可一世的上古神兽，仅仅是一踩一吞，就完全消灭了他们的教主。

“什么？你说话之前能不能考虑一下我的脑袋反应时间，我根本不知道你到底要做什么？”斯特兰奇有些崩溃的捂着脸。

罗成头疼，庞武确实才华横溢，自从看了蓝湛的品三国之后，他各种点评，甚至指出了一些不足之处。

伊铎知道，自己已经没有筹码了，眼前的这幅地图，将他坚守的唯一秘密打得粉碎。

如果说刚才，身为阿波罗军团的负责人，斯科特的心中，还有些瞧不起此人一副色欲熏心的表情，但是此时听到这句话后，无论是他还是上面的凯特琳，此刻却是尽皆蓦然一惊。

在如今的这个时候，在他们这里，叶天都这么说了，那他们还能说什么？

“叭叭”两声爆响，金丝猴腕部一抖，手中击出的树枝略生变化便已将烧向树枝的火球劈散成无数火星纷射消散，同时它身后长尾一扫，将烧向背后长毛的火球击爆扫灭，烧向眼睛的火球它则缩头一躲便避了开去。

她娇喝一声，将手里的双截棍飞动如银龙狂舞，让这三只瓢虫，只能围着她打转，一时间近不了身。

叶起对这个结果很是满意，现在杀伐之气对血肉傀儡的增益已经没有了，吸收了这样多的杀伐之气，让血肉傀儡到了一个趋于饱和的程度，叶起也不强求，不再满世界地找战场。

There, an old man in white shirt holding a sword in one hand stood on a boulder, standing among the ruins. In his hand was the intact Xuantu ancient sword.

"Your Majesty, this can't all be blamed on Captain Zhang." Seeing that Liu Bang was a little unhappy, Xiao He hurriedly put Zhang Liang in good words.

Afterwards, Bai Yang first recorded the data he had just tested, and then came to Megatron's side to prepare to repair his voice message system.

Qi Xuan felt a golden light in front of his eyes, which was extremely dazzling. After he couldn't help but close his eyes, he felt that the golden light disappeared instantly.

Even the second place last time was because China relied on its own efforts to restrict the three countries of ours from joining forces.

How could someone directly transform into an ancient divine beast that blocks out the sky and the sun, and completely wipe out their leader with just one step and one swallow?

"What? Before you speak, can you consider my brain's reaction time? I have no idea what on earth you are going to do?" Strange covered his face in collapse.

Luo Cheng had a headache. Pang Wu was indeed talented. After watching Lan Zhan's Three Kingdoms, he made various comments and even pointed out some shortcomings.

Iduo knew that he had no bargaining chips. The map in front of him shattered the only secret he held onto.

If just now, as the leader of the Apollo Corps, Scott still looked down on this person's lustful expression, but after hearing these words, both him and Caitlin above were suddenly shocked at this moment.

At this time, in their place, Ye Tian has said this, so what else can they say?

"Bah!" made two explosions. The golden monkey shook its wrist, and the branch it shot out of its hand slightly changed, splitting the fireball burning toward the branch into countless sparks that shot out and dissipated. At the same time, it swept its long tail behind, blasting away the fireball burning toward the hair on its back. It shrank its head and dodged away from the fireball burning toward its eyes.

She gave a sweet shout and flew the nunchucks in her hand like a silver dragon dancing wildly, causing the three ladybugs to circle around her and not be able to get close to her for a while.

Ye Qi was very satisfied with this result. Now the benefit of the killing energy to the flesh and blood puppets was gone. Having absorbed so much killing energy, the flesh and blood puppets had reached a level of saturation. Ye Qi did not force it and no longer searched for battlefields all over the world.
